test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 02 Feb 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: A shopkeeper offers a pen free on buying every dozen pens. Calculate % discount offered by the shopkeeper. Cost price of all the pens is same.(rounded off to one decimal place)
solution:
**Given:**

Cost of 13 pens is the cost of 12 pens

**Solution:**

% discount = ((Cost of 1 pen)/(Cost of 13 pens)) × 100%

⇒ % discount = (1/13) × 100%

⇒ % discount = 7.6%

**Therefore, the % discount offered by the shopkeeper is 7.6%.**
